france24fr.title: Cameroun : le gouvernement sort du silence sur l'affaire des décrets
france24fr.description:
🇨🇲 Au Cameroun, le gouvernement sort du silence sur l'affaire des décrets. Le mois dernier, un individu s'est rendu dans les locaux de la radio nationale à Yaoundé, et y a déposé un pli fermé contenant deux prétendus décrets présidentiels portant les nominations d'un vice-président de la République et d’un nouveau gouvernement.
 
Les documents officiels, n'avaient finalement pas été diffusés après vérification. Les précisions de notre correspondant à Yaoundé, Marcel Amoko.

france24fr.title: Présidentielle 2027: La question des ralliements, le RN suspendu à la décision de la cour d'appel
france24fr.description: A moins d’un an de la présidentielle, la politique entre dans le temps des calculs. Laurent Wauquiez, chef des Républicains à l’Assemblée nationale, n’exclut plus un rapprochement avec Edouard Philippe, marquant ainsi une rupture avec Bruno Retailleau. A gauche, en revanche le désordre règne : malgré les appels au rassemblement, les divisions l’emportent. Du côté du RN, la cour d’appel va rendre sa décision avec à la clé la possibilité ou non pour Marine Le Pen de se présenter en 2027.

france24fr.title: Régularisation des sans-papiers en Espagne : près de 1,2 million de demandes ont été déposées
france24fr.description: L'Espagne a reçu près de 1,2 million de demandes de régularisation entre mi-avril et le 30 juin. Deux tiers des étrangers en situation irrégulière ayant déposé un dossier sont originaires d'Amérique latine, selon des chiffres communiqués jeudi par le gouvernement socialiste de Pedro Sanchez.

france24fr.title: France : incendies majeurs dans le sud du pays
france24fr.description: Des centaines de pompiers luttent jeudi dans le Sud contre des incendies attisés par le vent, la sécheresse et la chaleur, le plus important dans l'Aude, mais aussi au nord de Marseille, où le Premier ministre Sébastien Lecornu est arrivé pour présider une nouvelle cellule interministérielle de crise.

france24fr.title: Guerre en Ukraine : la Russie au défi du brouillage de Starlink
france24fr.description: Des images montreraient la destruction, par les forces ukrainiennes, d'un système russe visant à brouiller les signaux Starlink, qui serait actuellement déployé sur le front. Ce réseau, particulièrement difficile à neutraliser, est devenu crucial pour fournir un accès à Internet à haut débit à l'Ukraine.

france24fr.title: La condamnation de Dany Leprince annulée dans un rebondissement rarissime
france24fr.description: Coup de tonnerre dans l'affaire Dany Leprince. L’homme avait été condamné à la prison à perpétuité en 1997 pour un quadruple meurtre dans la Sarthe. Il a déjà passé 18 ans derrière les barreaux, mais ce matin la Cour de révision a annulé sa condamnation... une décision rarissime. Un nouveau procès aura donc lieu.

france24fr.title: La fortune de Donald Trump bondit depuis son retour à la présidence des États-Unis
france24fr.description: Un rapport officiel qui vient de paraître nous apprend que le président américain s'est terriblement enrichi depuis son retour à la Maison Blanche il y a 18 mois. france24fr.description: Le bilan humain atteint des sommets en Ukraine. Au moins 17 personnes sont mortes cette nuit à Kiev après des attaques russes massives. Les explosions ont duré plusieurs heures dans la capitale. Des immeubles résidentiels se sont effondrés, piégeant des civils sous les décombres. france24fr.title: Séismes au Venezuela : un homme vivant sorti des décombres huit jours plus tard

spiegel.description: Als Prinzessin entschied sich die menschliche Fiona der Liebe willen für eine permanente Erscheinung als grüner Oger. Ein neuer Trailer zum fünften Film zeigt eine vermeintlich optimierte Version von ihr – zum Unmut im Netz.

spiegel.title: Südfrankreich: Brände zerstören Hunderte Hektar Land
spiegel.description: Wind und Trockenheit erschweren die Löscharbeiten: Rund 2000 Feuerwehrleute kämpfen in Südfrankreich gegen mehrere Feuer. Mehrere Orte mussten evakuiert werden, Züge konnten nicht fahren.

spiegel.title: Capital Bra: Rapper spricht über Tilidin-Sucht, Entzug und seine Jugend
spiegel.description: Capital Bra ist Millionen jungen Menschen ein Begriff, vielen ein Idol. Geboren in Sibirien, aufgewachsen in Berlin. Seitdem er elf ist, ist er abhängig von Tilidin. Mit dem SPIEGEL spricht er über Drogensucht und Erfolg.

spiegel.title: In Trump's Colony: Does the US Really Hold the Reins in Venezuela?
spiegel.description: Shortly before the earthquakes, DER SPIEGEL traveled to Venezuela to explore the question: Who is really in charge in the country?

spiegel.title: Grenzkontrollen: Verwaltungsgericht München entscheidet drei Klagen
spiegel.description: Ein Professor, ein Anwalt und ein Kraftfahrer klagten dagegen, dass sie an der Grenze zu Österreich kontrolliert wurden. Das Verwaltungsgericht München gab ihnen recht. Was folgt daraus?

spiegel.title: Carsten Schneider: Umweltminister geht vor Rügen tauchen
spiegel.description: Umweltminister Schneider war vor Rügen tauchen, um sich die Verschmutzung der Ostsee anzusehen. Damit setzt er eine lange deutsche Tradition fort: die von Umweltministern, die vor Kameras ins Wasser steigen.

spiegel.title: News des Tages: Krankschreibung ab Tag eins, Friedrich Merz und sein Reformpaket
spiegel.description: Die schwarz-roten Reformpaketboten haben geliefert. Was ändert sich bei Krankschreibung und Kündigungsschutz? Und ist das alles ein großer Wurf oder der kleinste gemeinsame Nenner? Das ist die Lage am Donnerstagabend.

spiegel.title: England und Wales: Keir Starmer entschuldigt sich für jahrzehntelange Zwangsadoptionen
spiegel.description: Mehr als 180.000 Babys unverheirateter Mütter wurden in England und Wales einst zwangsweise zur Adoption freigegeben. Der britische Premierminister Starmer bezeichnet das als »Schandfleck in unserer Geschichte«.

spiegel.title: Rapper Capital Bra über seine Drogensucht: »Hast du heute vor dem Interview Tilidin genommen?« – »Ja«
spiegel.description: Capital Bra ist einer der erfolgreichsten Musiker des Landes. Zuletzt machte sein Absturz Schlagzeilen, den er live streamte. Hier spricht er über seine Sucht, die Beatles und den Tag, an dem er Angst hatte, zu sterben.

spiegel.title: Gary Glitter: Staatsanwaltschaft wirft Ex-Popstar weitere Sexualverbrechen vor
spiegel.description: Gary Glitter war mal der große Star des Glamrock. Doch wegen sexuellen Missbrauchs mehrerer Kinder sitzt er seit Jahren im Gefängnis. Nun kommen neue Vorwürfe ans Licht.

spiegel.title: WM 2026 News heute: DFB soll Julian Nagelsmann den Rücktritt empfohlen haben
spiegel.description: Bundestrainer Julian Nagelsmann soll laut übereinstimmenden Medienberichten vor dem Aus stehen. Und: Norwegens Superstar Erling Haaland sorgt in seiner Heimat für Erschütterungen. Alles Wichtige zum Turnier.

spiegel.title: Venezuela: Mann acht Tage nach Erdbeben gerettet
spiegel.description: Rettungskräften aus sieben Ländern gelingt es gemeinsam, den Mitarbeiter eines eingestürzten Einkaufszentrums frei zu graben. Acht Tage war er unter Trümmern verschüttet – und ist nun ein Symbol der Hoffnung in Venezuela.

spiegel.title: Streik: Ver.di ruft zu bundesweitem Ausstand im Handel auf
spiegel.description: Beschäftigte im Handel kämpfen für höhere Löhne. Die Gewerkschaft Ver.di ruft deshalb für Freitag zu einem erneuten Ausstand auf. Geschlossen werden Geschäfte dabei wohl nicht.

spiegel.title: Reformpaket der Bundesregierung: Analyse zu Chancen und Knackpunkten
spiegel.description: Was bringt das Reformpaket der Regierung? Warum es ein wichtiger Schritt ist und wo die Knackpunkte liegen: eine Video-Analyse.

observador.title: FPTV. O canal português do Canadá
observador.description: Os portugueses têm uma das maiores comunidades de Toronto, são mais de 300 mil. Isto cria espaço para uma televisão que emite 24h e sempre em português. A FPTV tem sede na Little Portugal.

observador.title: Seleção Nacional atrai milhares de fãs em Toronto
observador.description: Adeptos luso-descendentes acompanham a seleção desde o hotel até ao estádio para poderem ver o jogadores, sobretudo Cristiano Ronaldo. Portugal-Croácia realiza-se esta quinta-feira, à meia-noite.

observador.title: Governo declara situação de alerta em todo o continente
observador.description: Medida entra em vigor a partir da meia-noite. Fogo-de-artifício, queimadas e trabalhos com maquinaria florestal estão proibidos. Luís Neves avisa que "não haverá espaço para as florestas arrefecerem".

observador.title: Espaço gerou 2,4 mil milhões em cinco anos
observador.description: Estudo revela que setor espacial multiplica por 2,17 o valor que traz à economia devido a cadeias de abastecimento e despesas de famílias. Estima-se uma produção de 2,4 mil milhões de euros em 5 anos.

observador.title: Kristin. 99% das comunicações repostas
observador.description: Paulo Fernandes, coordenador da Estrutura de Missão Reconstrução, revelou que 4,2 mil milhões já foram mobilizados e 3,6 mil milhões pagos ou disponibilizados aos beneficiários.

observador.title: Investigação. Publicado regulamento que impedia progressões
observador.description: Diploma foi acordado entre Governo e sindicatos. Progressão não acontecia desde 2008 por falta de regulamentação da avaliação de desempenho.

observador.title: Açores negam atraso de 4,2 milhões às IPSS
observador.description: União das IPSS dos Açores afirma estar em falta receber 4,2 milhões de euros em majorações e culpa Governo Regional que encomendou um estudo do custo real das instituições.

observador.title: Porto aguarda visto do TdC para os transportes gratuitos
observador.description: O presidente da Câmara do Porto acredita que o visto do Tribunal de Contas chegará "ainda durante o verão". A medida tem um custo máximo anual de 20,5 milhões de euros.

observador.title: UE quer propinas mais baixas para estudantes no Reino Unido
observador.description: As propinas para estudantes internacionais podem chegar aos 44 mil euros por ano. O Parlamento Europeu afirmou "estar a negociar" a questão que adiou repetidamente a segunda cimeira Reino Unido-UE.

observador.title: Obras na Quinta dos Ingleses vão a julgamento
observador.description: O movimento 66 Pela Quinta diz-se "confiante" na ação popular contra 850 fogos e um centro comercial junto à praia de Carcavelos. Sessões marcadas para 7, 9, 13 e 15 de julho.

observador.title: Circulação na Linha do Minho completamente restabelecida
observador.description: A circulação foi, numa primeira fase, restabelecida de forma condicionada, tendo sido completamente reposta cerca das 16h35.

observador.title: Melo: militares prontos para combate em momento "sensível"
observador.description: Governo declarou situação de alerta até segunda-feira. Ministro da Defesa garante militares em combate — não só prevenção — e apela: cada cidadão tem de "fazer o seu papel".

observador.title: Chega critica Montenegro no Mundial com país em alerta
observador.description: Pedro Pinto, líder parlamentar do Chega, entende que, a acreditar nos avisos que o Governo está a fazer sobre os riscos associados ao aumento das temperaturas, Montenegro não devia ter ido a Toronto.

observador.title: Hantavírus: OMS declara fim do surto ligado a navio
observador.description: Tedros Adhanom anunciou em Genebra o fim do surto que causou 3 mortes e 13 casos ligados ao cruzeiro. Origem da contaminação permanece desconhecida.

observador.title: Os últimos dias de uma mercearia em Lisboa
observador.description: O que procura a comunidade de norte-americanos que não se cansa de Portugal? Entramos em casas que valem milhões e trazemos uma história de bairro, no adeus ao balcão, 71 anos depois.

observador.title: Consumo de eletricidade atinge valor recorde no 1.º semestre
observador.description: Portugal consumiu 27.200 GWh de eletricidade no primeiro semestre, o valor mais alto de sempre. Renováveis cobriram 71% da procura, segundo dados da REN.

observador.title: Parlamento está a preparar Constituição em braille
observador.description: "Mais do que um símbolo, é um compromisso, o compromisso de afirmar que a Constituição pertence a todos os cidadãos.", afirmou o Presidente da Assembleia da República.

observador.title: É possível ser feliz a viver na ilusão?
observador.description: Projetamos imagens ideais para o exterior e para nós próprios. Eduardo Sá defende que a felicidade exige transparência e que o "Photoshop" emocional nas relações impede a verdadeira paz.

elpais.title: Vox entra en el Gobierno de Moreno con una vicepresidencia de Turismo, desregulación, justicia y administración local
elpais.description: El dirigente popular confirma que la prioridad nacional se apoya en el arraigo y no tendrá en cuenta la nacionalidad

elpais.title: El juez Pedraz imputa a la directora de la Guardia Civil y a su número dos en el ‘caso Leire’
elpais.description: El magistrado acoge la petición de la Fiscalía Anticorrupción y los cita el próximo 16 de julio por delitos de prevaricación y obstrucción a la justicia

elpais.title: La Comunidad de Madrid aprueba, ahora sí, su ley del concebido no nacido
elpais.description: La Asamblea celebra una sesión extraordinaria después de que se parara la tramitación de una de las normas en las que más empeño ha puesto la presidenta por un defecto de forma

elpais.title: La justicia busca a Vito Quiles por un bulo contra un empleado público: dijo que Yolanda Díaz le había excarcelado y enchufado
elpais.description: El agitador dijo que el hombre estuvo encarcelado por un delito grave y que Díaz logró que quedara libre y lo contrató en el Ministerio de Trabajo

elpais.title: España y la memoria perdida del KO: busca contra Austria superar una eliminatoria de un Mundial por primera vez en 16 años
elpais.description: La Roja, que no gana un cruce desde Sudáfrica en 2010, se enfrenta a la selección del creador de la contrapresión cuando su objetivo pasa por reencontrar la fluidez en su juego

elpais.title: La justicia obliga a Atresmedia a indemnizar a la socorrista del vídeo viral ‘La he liado parda’
elpais.description: La Audiencia de Madrid considera que el uso de la imagen y su voz en parodias lesionaron su honor y eleva la condena a 50.000 euros más intereses

elpais.title: “Al amigo Feu, de Sorolla”: el cuadro perdido en Sevilla vuelve a casa entre incógnitas
elpais.description: El lienzo de 1919, abandonado por error en la calle y encontrado por un turista murciano, regresa a manos de la familia propietaria sin aclarar a quién pertenecía originalmente y cómo lo obtuvieron

elpais.title: Medio mundo al rescate de Hernán: un venezolano sale con vida de entre los escombros tras ocho días sepultado por el terremoto
elpais.description: Un centenar de personas de diez países logran salvar al hombre en una operación contrarreloj en la que todos corrieron peligro por la situación inestable del edificio

elpais.title: Un último baile mundialista para Cristiano o Modric en un partido marcado por el primer aniversario de la muerte de Diogo Jota
elpais.description: Portugal y Croacia se miden en Toronto en dieciseisavos en un choque que supondrá el adiós definitivo de la Copa del Mundo de uno de los dos mitos. El ganador se verá con España o Austria en la siguiente ronda

elpais.title: ¿Cómo están los cruces del Mundial? Consulte los rivales probables de cada selección hasta la final
elpais.description: Un interactivo de EL PAÍS muestra el cuadro actualizado después de cada partido

elpais.title: Ni jugar ni ganar: el drama de Países Bajos y Alemania
elpais.description: Había un fondo común innegociable que se ha diluido con el tiempo, que era el de atacar, ir a por la victoria hasta el extremo de que la derrota se asumía como parte irremediable del proceso. Hoy se ha impuesto el resultadismo

elpais.title: Así desciframos qué país puede ganar el Mundial
elpais.description: La herramienta elaborada por EL PAÍS combina cuatro bancos de datos para hacer cálculos de probabilidades sobre cómo se pueden comportar las selecciones de fútbol durante la competición

elpais.title: Feijóomandering, o de la ‘ingeniería electoral’
elpais.description: Al líder del PP le parecía bien la ‘ley de nietos’ hasta que cayó en la cuenta de que el PSOE también puede hacer campaña en el exterior

elpais.title: Escuela de calor
elpais.description: El ministro de Trabajo francés quiere venir a España a aprender cómo seguimos vivos y trabajando con este calorazo, pero tampoco estamos para dar lecciones

elpais.title: Migraciones ha regularizado a cerca de 11.000 personas de un total de 1,17 millones de solicitudes presentadas
elpais.description: El 52% de los expedientes ha sido admitido a trámite por el momento y un 26% de ellos se ha dado de alta en la Seguridad Social

elpais.title: Beneficiados de la ‘ley de nietos’: “La nacionalidad es una forma de entender el origen”
elpais.description: Seis descendientes de emigrantes relatan su experiencia como nuevos ciudadanos españoles desde América

elpais.title: Francia absuelve a Josu Ternera y abre la vía para su extradición inmediata a España
elpais.description: El tribunal considera que no ha quedado probado que perteneciese a ETA entre 2002 y 2005, lo que liquida su periplo judicial en este país y despeja el camino para ejecutar las euroórdenes que pesan sobre él

elpais.title: La Abogacía del Estado concluye que Kitchen buscaba robar a Bárcenas “papeles que comprometían” a Rajoy
elpais.description: Las acusaciones exponen sus alegatos finales en el juicio: “Luis Bárcenas se tenía que callar, no podía perjudicar al PP”, dice la abogada del extesorero popular

nyt.title: Tucker Carlson, Who Broke With Trump, Plans to ‘Help Build a Third Party’
nyt.description: The influential conservative commentator’s relationship with the president and the G.O.P. fractured over the war with Iran. Now, he says he is charting a new course.

nyt.title: Republicans’ Home-Field Edge for Senate Seems Just Enough for Now
nyt.description: Democratic candidates are generally popular, Times/Siena polling finds, but retaking the Senate remains a big challenge.

nyt.title: Ocasio-Cortez Endorses Abdul El-Sayed in Crucial Michigan Senate Race
nyt.description: The endorsement is the first in a contested Senate primary by Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez this year, in a state that Democrats believe they must hold this fall to win a Senate majority.

nyt.title: Russia Bombards Ukrainian Capital With Deadly Wave of Attacks
nyt.description: At least 21 people were killed in drone and missile strikes on Kyiv that damaged several residential buildings across the city, the authorities said.

nyt.title: Putin Retaliates With New Strikes After Ukraine Takes the War to Russia
nyt.description: Ukraine is taking the war to Russia, but so far President Vladimir V. Putin’s response has been to keep attacking, including with deadly ballistic missile and drone strikes in Kyiv on Thursday.

nyt.title: Even as It Bombards Kyiv, Russia’s Wider Military Campaign Has Largely Stalled
nyt.description: Moscow can still inflict serious damage, but its forces are suffering higher casualties than their Ukrainian counterparts, analysts say.

nyt.title: Russia’s Deadly Attack on Ukraine Reminds Europe of Its Own Vulnerabilities
nyt.description: Governments across the continent have increased military spending, but the strikes are another warning that they need to be prepared if the conflict crosses into NATO territory.

nyt.title: US Job Market Makes Slower but Steady Gains, June Employment Data Shows
nyt.description: Employers added fewer jobs in June than a month earlier but the unemployment rate ticked down, a decent showing for the U.S. economy.

nyt.title: A.I. Is Reshaping the Economy. Good Luck Measuring How.
nyt.description: Some data suggest artificial intelligence is already causing job losses. Other sources show the opposite. Why is it so hard to figure out what’s going on?

nyt.title: An Aerial View of Disaster at a Venezuela Housing Project
nyt.description: What one aerial image of a collapsed building tells us about the aftermath of an earthquake in La Guaira, Venezuela.

nyt.title: A ‘Muslims Only’ Swim Party and the Backlash That Followed
nyt.description: A Muslim mother’s plan for an Eid swim party near Dallas drew backlash, then threats that upended her quiet life.

nyt.title: In Tumultuous Term, Chief Justice Roberts Took Charge of Unruly Supreme Court
nyt.description: The chief justice faced down the president, forged unlikely coalitions and achieved long-sought goals.

nyt.title: Iran Prepares to Bury Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, Killed at Iran War’s Outset
nyt.description: Long-delayed funeral ceremonies for Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, killed during U.S.-Israeli strikes at the war’s outset, are set to begin Friday. For the regime, it is a critical moment to demonstrate that it has endured.

nyt.title: U.S. Hopes for Investment in Iran Would Break With Decades of History
nyt.description: Senior U.S. officials have said Iran would be richly rewarded for changing its stance on the United States. Iran’s leaders have rejected such a bargain in the past.

nyt.title: The Logistics Behind Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s Madison Square Garden Wedding
nyt.description: The pop star is poised to host a wedding celebration at Madison Square Garden. The logistics in Midtown Manhattan over the July 4 weekend are complex.

nyt.title: Swifties Delight in Taylor’s Wedding Day
nyt.description: Fans see, in the pop star, reflections of their own lives: hope, heartbreak and now, finally, happiness.

nyt.title: How A.I. Might Change the Way Doctors Think
nyt.description: For generations, writing up a summary of a patient exam was a vital step for physicians trying to make an accurate diagnosis. What happens when A.I. does it for them?

nyt.title: Private Credit Can’t Stop the ‘Freak Out’
nyt.description: On Thursday, Blue Owl reported another quarter of significant investor withdrawal requests from some of its private credit funds.

npr.title: Trump denies conflict of interest over crypto. And, Vatican excommunicates rebel group
npr.description: Trump and his family earned over $1 billion last year through cryptocurrency ventures and other businesses. And, the Vatican declared that the traditionalist Society of St. Pius X has entered schism.

npr.title: Former ethics lawyer says Trump's crypto poses 'clear conflict of interest'
npr.description: Former White House ethics lawyer Richard Painter says President Trump "stands alone" in having substantial financial conflicts of interest and that, "for every other executive branch official, it would be a violation."

npr.title: Vatican declares Society of St. Pius X in schism, excommunicates bishops
npr.description: The Vatican responded Thursday to a traditionalist society that consecrated bishops without the pope's consent, declaring the Society of St. Pius X in schism and excommunicating its bishops and priests.

npr.title: Russia hits Ukraine's capital with a massive drone and missile attack, killing at least 18
npr.description: Russia launched a large-scale attack on Ukraine's capital overnight into Thursday, with ballistic and cruise missiles and drones, killing several people.

npr.title: U.S. and Iran hold separate meetings in Qatar and agree to continue discussions
npr.description: U.S. and Iranian negotiators met separately on Wednesday with Qatari and Pakistani mediators, with "positive progress made," and they agreed to continue discussions, host Qatar said.

npr.title: A major Russian attack kills 17 in Kyiv as Ukraine keeps striking Moscow's oil sector
npr.description: Loud explosions shook Kyiv for hours during the night, with many people sheltering at subway stations. Emergency crews were digging through the rubble of collapsed buildings in search of victims.

npr.title: Untold casualties and humanitarian needs: What to know a week from Venezuela's quakes
npr.description: Here's a look at some of the major developments since major back-to-back earthquakes rocked Venezuela on June 24, devastating parts of a country already reeling from crisis after crisis.

npr.title: Funerals held for 14 Pakistani children killed in tutoring center collapse
npr.description: Police are investigating whether negligence during construction work caused the collapse in the eastern city of Lahore on Tuesday.

npr.title: Greetings from London, where Banksy's flag man is a warning cry
npr.description: As he marches on, his flag blows back into his face, leaving him unaware he is only a step away from a perilous fall. As usual with Banksy's art, the statue presents a sharp critique of society.

npr.title: Mexico ends a 40-year knockout drought, beats Ecuador to advance in World Cup
npr.description: Mexico lost seven consecutive times at that same stage from 1994 to 2018 and didn't advance past the group stage in 2022. Now, the 40-year wait is over.

lanacion.description: Intriga, secretos familiares y tensión en un thriller de época que ya genera expectativa; todo lo que hay que saber sobre Verano del 36

lanacion.description: El delantero noruego se convirtió en la figura del Mundial no solo por su capacidad goleadora, sino por su enfoque relajado frente a la presión de la competencia; su actitud desafía los estándares de rigidez del deporte de élite

lanacion.description: La divisa oficial opera a $1510 para venta y se acerca a su máximo histórico; el dólar blue cotiza en $1525 para esa operación; qué pasa con el MEP y el CCL

lanacion.description: Las últimas noticias de la selección argentina, declaraciones de los jugadores y entrenadores, y reacciones sobre los partidos

lanacion.description: En comunicación con LN+, Andrés Repetto profundizó en el reciente ataque ruso en territorio ucraniano; se registraron 20 muertos y más de 90 heridos

lanacion.description: El reconocido psicólogo y escritor cuestionó los mandatos sociales y propuso una mirada sobre la finitud y el deseo

lanacion.description: El ingreso de una masa de aire de origen antártico mantiene temperaturas excepcionales en gran parte del país; se esperan nevadas en sectores del sudoeste bonaerense

lanacion.description: El conferencista analizó cómo el ego y la atención centrada en uno mismo impactan en la salud emocional; propuso la gratitud como herramienta inmediata

lanacion.description: El académico explicó la importancia de la amistad; explicó po qué el aprendizaje constante está directamente relacionado con el bienestar

lanacion.description: La especialista explicó cuáles son las herramientas que permiten atravesar una crisis; “La gente no se hunde solo por lo que pasa”, sostuvo

lanacion.description: Los grandes torneos de fútbol pueden intensificar el estrés, alterar el descanso y potenciar síntomas físicos; Juan Ingelmo, especialista del Hospital de Clínicas, explicó por qué ocurre este fenómeno y compartió recomendaciones

lanacion.description: Jorge Tartaglione visitó LN+ y sostuvo que “la gente con obesidad no es haragana: se trata de una enfermedad crónica”; “En 40 años como médico es la primera vez que veo algo así”, reveló

lanacion.description: El especialista hizo hincapié en LN+ en los estudios que los fumadores o exfumadores deberían realizarse; “mi padre murió de un cáncer de pulmón por fumador”, confesó

straits.title: Rebel Catholic group in Switzerland unrepentant over excommunication
straits.description: ECONE, Switzerland, July 2 - Members of a breakaway Catholic group excommunicated over the ordination of four bishops were unrepentant on Thursday, accusing the Church of straying from the true faith and saying Pope Leo had failed to hear their concerns.

straits.title: When Russia strikes, Kyiv's volunteer rescuers rush to help
straits.description: KYIV, July 2 - Max, a graphic designer, helped find survivors in a Kyiv apartment building blown apart by a Russian missile on Thursday before heading to work — one of around 700 volunteer rescuers with the Ukrainian Red Cross.

phys-org.description: In the humid jungle of Vietnam, Natalia Ocampo-Peñuela and Monte Neate-Clegg spent hours patiently waiting to spot the rare "Halloween bird." phys-org.description: Worker bees are the first line of defense when it comes to removing contamination in honeybee colonies, but a queen has her ways, too. phys-org.description: Human embryo models can help researchers study early human development and infertility without relying solely on human embryos. As the technology advances, these models are becoming more complex and can be maintained in culture for longer periods. undark.title: Making Sense of Data From Wearable Health Trackers

undark.title: Promising ‘Liquid Biopsies’ May Not Be Ready for Primetime

undark.title: Book Review: How Radio Astronomy Made the Invisible Visible

undark.title: Risk Aversion in Science Stifles Innovation
undark.description: Does the scientific enterprise play it too safe? C. Brandon Ogbunu argues that risk-taking in science involves a willingness to reflect on the processes and incentives of the profession — and to dramatically overhaul them if they do not work. Only then can true scientific innovation take shape.

proj-syn.title: 250 Years of American State Capitalism
proj-syn.description: While the prevailing economic narrative in the United States has often extolled free markets, policymaking itself has always been more pragmatic. From its very founding, the US has had a hybrid model in which the state directs, subsidizes, and occasionally bails out private enterprise in the service of national priorities.

proj-syn.title: Three Essentials of a More Equal World Order
proj-syn.description: A growing awareness of the inequities embedded in the world order has prompted calls for reform. Building a multilateral system that serves the global majority will require redesigning the international financial architecture, especially in relation to sovereign debt and corporate taxation.

proj-syn.title: The US as the World’s Robber Baron
proj-syn.description: Like the Gilded Age robber barons, the United States under President Donald Trump is using trade policy to benefit itself at the expense of all other countries. But now that administration surrogates are openly acknowledging the strategy, all other major trading powers will surely respond accordingly.

proj-syn.title: A Democratic Opening for Azerbaijan
proj-syn.description: With Armenia's recent elections likely to usher in an era of greater stability—and less Russian influence—in the South Caucasus, neighboring Azerbaijan is well-positioned to deepen cooperation with the US and Europe. But without appropriate conditions, new strategic partnerships with the West could fail to deliver for Azerbaijanis.

proj-syn.title: The Mismeasure of Europe’s Economy
proj-syn.description: While Nobel laureate economists Paul Krugman and Philippe Aghion disagree over how to measure Europe’s productivity gap with the United States, both overlook the value of its accumulated assets. That blind spot obscures the real story: Europe is living off a remarkable inheritance it has yet to convert into new growth.

proj-syn.title: NATO Needs a Defense Market
proj-syn.description: To convert NATO members' resources into military capabilities, setting defense as a strategic priority, increasing spending, and improving procurement systems are all steps in the right direction. But member countries will need to expand their industrial capacity—and that requires much more.

proj-syn.title: The Digital Choices Shaping our Children’s Health
proj-syn.description: Around the world, childhood is being reprogrammed by digital technologies that shape how young people learn, play, and connect. But children and young people are not experimental subjects, a captive market, or a commodity, which is why we must shape digital environments that protect and support their healthy development.

proj-syn.title: Oligarchy’s Ancient Origins
proj-syn.description: The struggle between democracy and oligarchy in classical Greece was bitter, with oligarchies relying on skillfully designed political institutions to shore up unpopular regimes. As concerns grow over the “rule of the few” in the United States, Americans should consider how their own institutions are doing oligarchs’ work for them.

proj-syn.title: How Modi Has Remade India
proj-syn.description: Over the last 12 years, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi has overseen dizzying progress in economic modernization and state capacity-building, as well as dismaying setbacks on institutional independence and minority inclusion. This record offers important insights into how India will navigate the 21st century.
